_comment: Authored documentation corpus for the classic Operation Flashpoint / Cold War Assault command set. The engine ships no in-binary doc strings, so the prose here is authored, NOT mechanically extracted. It is kept honest by tests/docs_grounded.rs (poseidon-catalog) and tests/doc_examples.rs (poseidon-syntax): every `name` must be a real catalog command, and every `examples` entry must lex clean and type-check clean against the engine-faithful checker. Signatures/arg-types are rendered from the catalog, never duplicated here. Keyed case-insensitively by `name`.

player.description: The unit the local human player controls. The single most-used entry point in mission scripts.

setDamage.description: Sets the total damage of an object: 0 is pristine, 1 is destroyed (dead for a person). Spreads across hit points. Same as setDammage (the original British spelling shipped in OFP).

setDammage.description: Original-spelling alias of setDamage: 0 pristine, 1 destroyed. Both spellings are registered commands in this engine.

getDammage.description: Current total damage of an object, 0 (pristine) to 1 (destroyed). Read-side counterpart of setDamage.

alive.description: True while the object exists and is not destroyed (damage < 1). The standard liveness test for people and vehicles.

fuel.description: Fuel level of a vehicle as a fraction, 0 (empty) to 1 (full).

setFuel.description: Sets a vehicle's fuel level as a fraction 0..1.

setCaptive.description: Marks a unit as captive (true) or not (false). A captive unit is treated as friendly/neutral by all sides and will not be fired on.

allowDamage.description: Enables (true) or disables (false) damage to an object. While false the object is invulnerable.

removeAllWeapons.description: Strips every weapon and magazine from a unit.

addWeapon.description: Adds a weapon (by class name) to a unit's inventory.

addMagazine.description: Adds one magazine (by class name) to a unit's inventory.

getPos.description: World position of an object as [x, y, z] in metres. z is height above ground level.

position.description: World position of an object as [x, y, z]. Equivalent to getPos for objects.

setPos.description: Teleports an object to a world position given as [x, y, z]. A z of 0 puts it on the ground.
examples: _heli setPos [getPos player select 0, getPos player select 1, 50]

getDir.description: Compass heading of an object in degrees, 0 (north) to 360 clockwise.

setDir.description: Instantly turns an object to a compass heading in degrees (0 = north, clockwise).

setVelocity.description: Sets an object's velocity vector [x, y, z] in metres per second. Useful for launching or nudging physics objects.

velocity.description: An object's current velocity as [x, y, z] in metres per second.

distance.description: Distance in metres between two objects. NOTE: in this classic engine distance takes an OBJECT on both sides — there is no object-to-position form (that was added later in Arma).

name.description: The display name of a person (the editor-assigned or generated soldier name).

typeOf.description: The config class name of an object, e.g. "SoldierWB". Empty string for objects without a type.

side.description: The side of a unit or group: west, east, resistance (guer) or civilian.

group.description: The group a unit belongs to. Pass it to units to enumerate members.

units.description: Array of all units in a group (or in the group of a given unit). Iterate with forEach.
examples: {_x setCaptive true} forEach units group player

leader.description: The current leader of a group (or of the group a unit is in).

vehicle.description: The vehicle a unit is in, or the unit itself when on foot. Use to distinguish mounted from dismounted.

driver.description: The unit in the driver's seat of a vehicle.

gunner.description: The unit in the gunner's seat of a vehicle.

commander.description: The unit in the commander's seat of a vehicle.

knowsAbout.description: How well a unit (or its group) knows about a target, from 0 (no knowledge) to 4 (fully identified).

reveal.description: Makes a unit/group instantly aware of a target object, as if it had spotted it.

setBehaviour.description: Sets a unit's or group's combat behaviour: "CARELESS", "SAFE", "AWARE", "COMBAT" or "STEALTH".

doMove.description: Orders a unit or group to move to a position [x, y, z] without a radio callout (silent move).

doFollow.description: Orders a unit to return to formation and follow a target unit (silent).

createVehicle.description: Spawns a vehicle/object of the given class at a position. Classic forms: "type" createVehicle [x,y,z], or createVehicle [type, pos, markers, radius, placement].

createUnit.description: Creates a person of the given class into an existing group: "type" createUnit [pos, group, init, skill, rank].

deleteVehicle.description: Removes an object from the world immediately.

nearestObject.description: The nearest object to a position, optionally filtered. Argument is an array such as [position] or [position, type].

hint.description: Shows a hint box with the given text in the top-left of the screen. Combine with format for dynamic text.

titleText.description: Displays centred title text. Argument is [text, type, speed] where type is "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", etc.

cutText.description: Like titleText but shown on the secondary (cut) layer, so it does not interrupt a title. Argument is [text, type, speed].

format.description: Builds a string from a template and values: format ["text %1 and %2", a, b]. %1, %2 ... are replaced by the following array elements stringified.

playMusic.description: Plays a music track defined in CfgMusic by its class name.

playSound.description: Plays a sound defined in CfgSounds by its class name (2D, non-positional).

if.description: Begins a conditional. Returns an If value to be consumed by then: if (condition) then {…} else {…}. Like all control words in this engine, if is an ordinary command, not a reserved keyword.

then.description: Runs the code that follows when the preceding if is true. Pair with else as then {…} else {…}, or use a single block.

else.description: Joins the true and false branches into the pair consumed by then: then { … } else { … }.

while.description: Begins a conditional loop. Returns a While value consumed by do: while {condition} do {body}. The condition is a code block, re-evaluated each iteration.

forEach.description: Runs a code block once per element of an array. Inside the block _x is the current element. Written as {body} forEach array.
examples: {_x setCaptive true} forEach units group player

exitWith.description: When used after if, runs its block and exits the current script: if (condition) exitWith {…}.

call.description: Executes a code block (compiled string) immediately and returns its result. Optionally takes arguments on the left.

private.description: Declares one or more variable names local to the current scope: private "_x" or private ["_x", "_y"].

select.description: Picks an element from an array by zero-based index, or by boolean (false→first, true→second): array select index.

count.description: Number of elements in an array (unary), or the number matching a condition string (binary): "alive _x" count units _grp.

in.description: True if the left value is an element of the right array, or (object form) if a unit is in a vehicle.
examples: if (player in units group player) then {hint "member"}

random.description: A pseudo-random number from 0 (inclusive) up to the given value (exclusive).

sin.description: Sine of an angle given in degrees.

cos.description: Cosine of an angle given in degrees.

setMarkerPos.description: Moves a map marker (by name) to a position [x, y, z].

setMarkerType.description: Changes a map marker's icon type (by name) to a marker class string.

getMarkerPos.description: Position [x, y, z] of a named map marker.

publicVariable.description: Broadcasts a global variable's current value to every machine in a multiplayer session. Argument is the variable name as a string.
